name: Pieter Vermeer
bio:
Pieter's journey into motorsport analytics began unconventionally, after a career in logistics left him yearning for something more stimulating. He spent years honing his data analysis skills in his spare time, initially focusing on Formula 1 race data available online. His meticulous approach and keen eye for identifying trends led to consultancy work for smaller racing teams. Now, Pieter is eager to bring his analytical prowess to a larger organization.

He believes that data tells a story, and it's his job to decipher that narrative for the benefit of the team. Pieter is particularly interested in developing predictive models to optimize race strategy and identify areas for performance improvement. His ambition is to become a leading data strategist within the motorsport industry, known for uncovering hidden advantages through innovative data analysis techniques. He is an independent contractor and a free agent.

physical.description: Pieter is of average height with a slight build, giving him a focused and intellectual appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with statistical observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of mechanical keyboard for optimal data input.
